scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Who is this?

I am the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Before we discuss anything, I need to verify your identity. Could you please share your date of birth, or the last four digits of your registered mobile number?
Sure, my date of birth is 18 December 1983.

Thank you, Deepa. This is regarding an important matter on your account. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees was due on the twentieth of October and is now fourteen days overdue. How would you like to proceed?

Yes, I know it's overdue, I'm really sorry about that. I lost my job recently and I just can't afford to pay right now — is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced, skipped, or delayed this month?

I understand this is a difficult time for you. I have flagged your account for a colleague to call you back regarding your situation. They will reach out to you soon. Thank you for your time, have a good day.
Wait, before you go — so no late fee will be charged for now? Can you confirm when exactly someone will call me, because I need this in writing or confirmed by a person before I can rely on it.
I cannot confirm any fee changes or give you a specific callback time right now. A colleague will call you back soon to discuss this. Thank you for your time, have a good day.
Please, I really need something confirmed — can I at least get a reference number or an email saying someone will call me? Otherwise how do I know this was even noted on my account?

I understand you need confirmation, but I am unable to provide a reference number or send an email from here. A colleague will contact you directly to assist you further. Thank you for your time, have a good day.
Okay... fine. But please make sure someone actually calls me soon, I'm depending on this. Thank you.
I have noted everything down. Thank you for your time, have a good day.

args.notes: Borrower reported recent job loss and requested hardship assistance, fee reduction, or delay. Escalated to human team.

outcome.notes: Borrower reported recent job loss and requested hardship assistance, fee reduction, or delay. Escalated to human team.
